case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for the options; however, shifting to DAP and a 35-day lead time adds substantial freight and expediting costs that were not in our initial calculation. To offer you the most competitive rate, we propose maintaining EXW delivery and a 45-day lead time, which allows us to reduce our price to EUR 15.90. If DAP and a 35-day lead time are mandatory, we can accommodate them, but the unit price would need to increase above our initial offer to cover the difference. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. We can also present an alternative package at our standard terms featuring a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
